Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1001234": On 2026-04-14, the Dune team observed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners.  (about: Dune team, reporting service, Tuesday's deploy)
- memory_id "1001076" [decision]: Follow-up decision from the INC-2026-003 review: the webhook dispatcher will require an idempotency key on every delivery, because duplicate deliveries in INC-2026-003 came from retries without one.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003, idempotency key)
- memory_id "1001070": The cause of INC-2026-003 was a retry loop that ignored idempotency keys.  (about: INC-2026-003, retry loop, idempotency key)
- memory_id "1001066": During INC-2026-003, the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20.  (about: webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003)
- memory_id "1000922": On 2025-12-01, the Boreal team observed that the job scheduler's cold start time tripled following the runtime upgrade, and since it was not their service, they flagged it.  (about: Boreal team, job scheduler, runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000787" [decision]: Reindex jobs will page on failure, because a silent reindex failure left stale results for two days in INC-2025-023.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000783": The root cause of INC-2025-023 was a reindex job that failed silently on a full disk.  (about: INC-2025-023, reindex job)
- memory_id "1000779": The indexer served stale results for two days on 2025-10-03 during incident INC-2025-023.  (about: indexer, INC-2025-023)
- memory_id "1000743": The reporting service stopped using the ledger service because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000715" [decision]: Ownership of the job scheduler transferred from the Dune team to the Cinder team on 2025-09-23.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000711": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team, not the Dune team.  (about: Dune team, job scheduler, Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000640" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000626": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: INC-2025-017, intermediate certificate)
- memory_id "1000622": During INC-2025-017, the authentication gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: authentication gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000525" [decision]: The job scheduler is owned by the Dune team as of 2025-06-25, when ownership moved from the Ember team.  (about: Dune team, Ember team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000521": On 2025-06-25, Oskar walked Farah through the job scheduler runbook.  (about: Farah, Oskar, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000474" [decision]: As of 2025-06-06, the job scheduler will use leader election instead of a single fixed node.  (about: job scheduler, leader election)
- memory_id "1000455": The root cause of INC-2025-011 was an index missing after the schema migration.  (about: INC-2025-011, index, schema migration)
- memory_id "1000175": The root cause of INC-2025-004 was a consumer offset stuck after a broker restart.  (about: INC-2025-004)
- memory_id "1000171": The notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01 during incident INC-2025-004.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
Existing entity names: Dune team, reporting service, Tuesday's deploy, webhook dispatcher, INC-2026-003, idempotency key, retry loop, Boreal team, job scheduler, runtime upgrade, INC-2025-023, reindex job, indexer, ledger service, Cinder team, INC-2025-017, intermediate certificate, authentication gateway, Ember team, Farah, Oskar, leader election, INC-2025-011, index, schema migration, INC-2025-004, notifier
